android._comment: Stays 0 = dormant (isStale returns false for latest<=0, so no Android build is ever nudged). vc6 (1.5) is the newest Android binary, so nobody is behind. Pre-vc6 APKs have no getBuildNumber bridge and readBinaryBuild returns Infinity for Android (never stale); vc6 users already report 6 and are current. Bump this only once a vc7+ ships AND most users are on vc6+ (bridge-bearing), so the comparison is meaningful instead of inert.
